records.title: Utilisation of funds under NCAP, 2026
details:
a to e: Central Pollution Control Board issued “Conceptual Guidelines and Common Methodology for Air Quality Monitoring, Emission Inventory (EI) & Source Apportionment (SA) Studies for Indian
Cities.” SPCBs/PCCs take up Source Apportionment Studies through various academic/ research institutes for respective cities under NCAP in line with the CPCB guidelines to identify various
factors contributing to air pollution and prioritise the air quality improvement measures under city action plans. Source Apportionment (SA) studies have been carried out in 90 cities of NCAP and remaining 40 cities have initiated the studies and are at various stages.

records.title: Production of Paraquat.
details: a to g): Further, a sub-committee has been constituted on the directions of Government of India to review the safety, efficacy and toxicity of Paraquat dichloride.

records.title: Cross Border Power Transmission
details: a: Further, cross-border power transmission lines with Nepal, Bangladesh, Myanmar and Sri Lanka have been planned. Moreover, new cross-border interconnections with UAE, Saudi Arabia and Singapore are under discussion.

records.title: Implementation of PM-KUSUM
details:
d) As reported by the SIA, the state has set a target of coverage of 10 lakh household under
PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (PMSG:MBY), not under PM-KUSUM. Under PMSG:
MBY, 25,000 households are planned to be covered by the state for Bapatla PC.
